That boundary feels right. When I cleared both fields and tried to save, it didn't let the bookmark through — it kept the review open and asked me for a title, with a note that a title is what lets me recognize the bookmark later. Then once I typed "Roast potatoes" and left the description blank, it saved fine. So a title is required and a description is optional, which matches how I think about it: a bookmark with no name at all would be useless to me, but plenty of things don't need a blurb.
